author: cod769
body:
Hi, my name in-game is cod769 and I was temp-banned for abusing glitches-boots today and I was not doing anything wrong or at least i think. Today i was playing nebula on your server when i joined a match and it said in my hand to select kit since i haven play in a while i didn't know if it was for donator or anything like that so i chose spy it said kit selected and when i joined the match i was invisible which i assumed was the kit then i saw i had boots on so i took them off to be completely invisible and at this time i was playing with a friend who was ridergrl and she said i was invisible which also said i had infinite inadvisability in my potions slot in the inventory. After using a kit for a while i killed someone named FriendlyModOscar when i had the jump on him. He kicked me saying the same thing as the ban above i thought it was an abuse of power or something like that so i re-joined and after a bit again of the same class i killed him again and he banned me with no warning or any explanation with anything even though someone else on both his and my team were using the same kit. If it was for a donator or something like that im sorry and i did not know it was a glitch and i will take the ban or at least if he told me what was going on but since i am uninformed i would like to be un-banned for these reasons.

-thanks, cod769
sorry for bad grammar

When you select the scout kit it specifically says in bold "Please do not take the boots off", you are not suppose to take the boots off. I'm not going to appeal this punishment, just serve your time it isn't that long.
